title: 第十九章 明照自我第二十章 道术奇才
content_zh:
姓名：周无纪（八品）
寿命：85
精神（神）：323
真炁（炁）：425
身体（精）：121
北斗天枢经：熟练
潇湘剑法：小成
……
周无纪看着书页上呈现出的数据，他心里还是颇为满意。
精神、身体、真炁的数据，是他以自己才打通神窍的状态为基准，精炁神三项数据都设定为一百。
不论是哪家修炼门派，其根本都是精炁神三宝。
神是精神，炁是真炁。其中的精，其实都是指的修者身体。
把精炁神数据化，他就能清楚看到自己修为的进境。
至于法术、武功，其实都是应用的术和法，不是道，不是根本。
周无纪看了几遍自己数据，他觉得精神的增长有点太快了。
真炁提升是源于穴窍打通，才能迅速进步。
精神怎么会增长这么快？
他突然想到了北帝天刑书转化的本源玄灵和本源玄炁。
本源玄炁是炁，那本源玄灵就是神吧？
转化那么多人的命格，不止是提升了剑法，也让他精神获得了巨大增长？

周无纪也不确定，只能等他再次吸收本源玄灵，就可以进行验证了。
真是如此的话，那北帝天刑书还能转化出本源玄精？
周无纪又生出几分期待，真要如此的话，那他修行就变得很简单了，只要多杀妖魔鬼怪就行了。
他又在心里提醒自己，北帝天刑书戒律森严，他却不受戒律约束，这才能飞速进步。
他可以不管北帝天刑书的戒律，却要有自己的道，有自己的原则。
第二天上午，一平道人带着周无纪来到传法殿。
一平道人从执事那拿到一本道术总录，上面列明了各个品级对应的各种法术。
周无纪这几天在飞玄殿，其实已经看过这本书了。他也早就想好了要学习的法术。
一平道人低声对周无纪说道：“减免费用，也不能多选。五到七种法术比较合适。”
他建议道：“七星诛魔剑，是八品修行法门，对应上丹田九窍，必学。
“除此之外，净心神咒也是必学。此咒内能净神定心，外能帮人驱除邪祟鬼魔，很是重要。”
周无纪点头，师叔说得是正理，法术并不是学得越多越好。
这不是吃相好坏的问题，而是法术修炼繁复，想要在一门法术上有所成就，就要投入大量精力和资源。
就像回春术，他要没有北帝天刑书转化的本源玄灵，练一辈子也未必能精通此术。
他就是有北帝天刑书，也不能在无关紧要法术上浪费本源玄灵。
周无纪又选了三门法术，分别是火铃咒、六阳法眼、五阴兜。
火铃咒其实是九品法术，等级很低。
没有传承的江湖道人，大都会一手火铃符。符纸一摇迎风化作烈焰，看上去很唬人。
实际上火铃咒是驱散阴气的符法，可为咒，可为符。
正经道士修炼火铃咒，大多是为了生火方便。

六阳法眼是八品中高阶法术，此法能让修者看到邪祟、鬼灵、阴气。
修炼到高妙之处，双眼催发六阳法力直接灭杀邪祟鬼灵。
最后一门五阴兜，却是以五道阴灵编织成兜，用以承载没有生命的物品。这也是周无纪早就看中的法术。
content_en:
Name: Zhou Wuji (eighth grade)
Lifespan: 85
Spirit (god): 323
True Qi (Qi): 425
Body (essence): 121
Beidou Tianshu Sutra: Proficient
Xiaoxiang Sword Technique: Xiao Cheng
…
Zhou Wuji looked at the data presented on the page, and he was quite satisfied.
The data of mental, physical, and spiritual energy were based on the state in which he had just opened his spiritual aperture. The three data of spiritual energy and spiritual energy were all set at 100.
No matter which cultivation sect it is, its foundation is the Three Treasures of Spirit and Spirit.
God is the spirit, Qi is the true Qi. The essence among them actually refers to the body of the cultivator.
By converting Jingqi Shen into data, he can clearly see the progress of his cultivation.
As for magic and martial arts, they are actually applied techniques and methods, not Tao or fundamental.
Zhou Wuji looked at his own data several times and felt that his spiritual growth was a bit too fast.
The improvement of true energy comes from the opening of acupuncture points, so that rapid progress can be made.
How could the spirit grow so fast?
He suddenly thought of the Origin Xuanling and Origin Xuanqi transformed from the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book.
The original Xuanqi is Qi, so the original Xuanling is a god, right?
Transforming the lives of so many people not only improved his swordsmanship, but also gave him a huge spiritual growth?
Zhou Wuji was not sure either and could only verify it after he absorbed the original mysterious spirit again.
If this is the case, can the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book transform the original Xuanjing?
Zhou Wuji had some expectations again. If this was really the case, then his cultivation would become very simple, as long as he killed more demons and ghosts.
He reminded himself in his mind that the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book had strict precepts, but he was not bound by the precepts, so he could make rapid progress.
He can ignore the precepts of Beidi's Heavenly Punishment Book, but he must have his own way and his own principles.
The next morning, Taoist Yiping took Zhou Wuji to the Dharma Transmission Hall.
Taoist Yiping got a general catalog of Taoism from the deacon, which listed various spells corresponding to each level.
Zhou Wuji had actually read this book in Feixuan Hall these days. He had already thought about the spells he wanted to learn.
Taoist Yiping whispered to Zhou Wuji: "There is no fee reduction, and you cannot choose more than one. Five to seven spells are more suitable."
He suggested: "The Seven-Star Demon-Slaying Sword is an eighth-level cultivation method, which corresponds to the nine orifices of the Dantian and must be learned.
“In addition, the Purifying Mantra is also a must-learn. This mantra can purify the mind and calm the mind internally, and can help people drive away evil spirits and demons externally, which is very important. "
Zhou Wuji nodded. His uncle was right. The more spells you learn, the better.
This is not a question of whether one's appearance is good or bad, but the practice of spells is complicated. If you want to achieve success in a spell, you must invest a lot of energy and resources.
Just like the rejuvenation technique, if he didn't have the original mysterious spirit transformed by Beidi's Heavenly Punishment Book, he might not be able to master this technique after practicing it for a lifetime.
Even if he has the Beidi Heavenly Punishment Book, he cannot waste his original mysterious spirit on irrelevant spells.
Zhou Wuji chose three more spells, namely the Fire Bell Curse, the Six-Yang Dharma Eye, and the Five-Yin Pocket.
The Fire Bell Spell is actually a ninth-level spell with a very low level.
Taoists who have no inheritance will usually have a fire bell talisman. The talisman shook in the wind and turned into flames, which looked very scary.
In fact, the fire bell spell is a talisman to dispel yin energy. It can be a curse or a talisman.
Serious Taoist priests practice the Fire Bell Mantra mostly for the convenience of making fire.
The Six-Yang Dharma Eye is an eighth-grade mid-to-high-level spell that allows practitioners to see evil spirits, ghosts, and yin energy.
When you practice to a high level, your eyes can activate the six yang magic powers to directly kill evil spirits.
The last five-yin bag is made of five yin spirits woven into a bag to carry inanimate objects. This is also a spell that Zhou Wuji has long been interested in.
